No, I don’t have fever or chills.

No, I don’t have new muscle weakness like that, and I don’t have drooping eyelids or trouble swallowing.
[ASK] Do you have **sudden onset chest pain or shortness of breath** that is **severe and started within the last few hours** (or are you currently in an acute episode)?
No—no sudden severe chest pain or shortness of breath, and I’m not in an acute episode like that.
[ASK] Do you have **heartburn or acid regurgitation** (burning behind the breastbone, sour taste, worse after meals/lying down)?

No, I don’t have chest pain that’s worse with breathing or coughing, and I haven’t had vomiting or retching.
[ASK] Do you have symptoms of nasal/sinus inflammation (e.g., nasal congestion, sinus pain/pressure, purulent nasal discharge)?
No, I don’t have nasal congestion or sinus pressure, and I don’t have any thick/pus-like nasal discharge.
[ASK] Do you have a painful swelling or bulge in the groin that becomes more noticeable when coughing or straining?
No, I don’t have a painful swelling or bulge in my groin.
[ASK] Do you have swelling localized to one area (localized edema) rather than generalized swelling?
No, I haven’t noticed swelling in just one localized area.
[ASK] Do you have severe one-sided headache attacks around/behind one eye with tearing or nasal congestion that come in bouts?
No, it’s not like sudden severe one-sided headache attacks with tearing or nasal congestion in bouts. My headache is more in the forehead and both temples.
